JoyNews’ #NoToGalamsey campaign wins CIMG New Media Campaign of the Year
results.description: JoyNews’ #NoToGalamsey campaign has been named New Media Campaign of the Year for 2025 at the 37th Annual National Marketing Performance Awards organised by the Chartered Institute of Marketing, Ghana (CIMG). The award was presented at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra on Saturday, October 17, 2026, in recognition of the campaign’s use of digital platforms to extend the reach of its reporting on illegal mining and its effects on water bodies and communities. In its citation, CIMG said the campaign had used digital conversations to broaden public engagement with the issue.

results.title: Multimedia Group’s #NoToGalamsey campaign wins CIMG New Media Campaign Award
results.description: The Multimedia Group’s anti-galamsey campaign, Galamsey Fight (#NoToGalamsey), has won the New Media Campaign Award at the 37th Annual National Marketing Performance Awards. The award, presented by the Chartered Institute of Marketing, Ghana (CIMG), was announced in a letter to the Multimedia Group. The ceremony took place at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra on Saturday, October 17, 2026. CIMG recognised the campaign for its ability to communicate its message effectively, appeal to its audience and make a positive impact on society. The institute also commended the ethical execution of its informative and educational content. The recognition highlights the role of media-led advocacy in drawing public attention to illegal mining and its effects on Ghana’s environment and communities.

results.title: Microplastics Generate Reactive Radicals in Water, New Study Finds
results.description: A study published Oct. 14 in Nature shows microplastics spontaneously generate reactive oxygen species in water through surface interactions. The activity rises with the plastic's hydrophobicity and tracked protein aggregation and damage to mouse red blood cells in lab tests. The researchers say it may be an overlooked mechanism behind microplastics' harmful effects.
